13917.d: Hydrix dragons are high-level Slayer monsters requiring level 101 Slayer to kill.
13917.ex: A dragon decorated in hydrix gems.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The gemstone cavern is located inside the gem mine in the northern-western part of Shilo Village on Karamja. To be able to enter the cave players must have completed the hard Karamja achievements. To access the mine players can teleport directly to the gem mine with the option in the Karamja gloves 3 or 4. 

Hydrix dragons can also be found in the Wilderness, near the Lava Maze mine and in the Deep Wilderness Dungeon.
